releases.title: Chat, leaderboards and your profit graph

items.title: Table chat you can't miss
items.detail: Chat now has its own box under the log, with one-tap replies like gg and nh. On a phone, tap the chat button at the top (it shows how many messages you've missed). New messages pop up beside the player's seat for a few seconds, and Enter jumps to the chat box.

items.title: Bet in big blinds
items.detail: With the Chips | BB switch on BB, you can type and bet in big blinds too. Type 3 to raise to three big blinds.

items.title: A steadier table
items.detail: The table keeps one size through a hand, empty seats keep clear of players, and the pot shows as one line. People, How to play, shortcuts and Look and sound now live in one Menu at the top of the table, and runs of "sat down" lines in the log fold into one.

items.title: Leaderboard
items.detail: See who's up this month, this year or all time on the new Leaderboard page, ranked by profit, hands played or biggest pot. Only real cash games count: practice tables with bots and tournaments are left out. Anyone with the link can see it.

items.title: Your profit graph
items.detail: Your profile now draws your results game by game, so you can see how your nights add up.

items.title: Search your hands
items.detail: Find hands you played by your cards (like AA or AKs), who you played with, the game, pot size or how it went, then replay or share them.

items.title: Tidy up your records
items.detail: Hide a cash table from your profile (it stays for everyone else), and hosts can delete a test table nobody really played at.

items.title: A cleaner front page
items.detail: A menu across the top of every page outside the tables, two big choices on the home page (start a cash game or host a tournament), tidier tournament lobby and setup screens, and simpler sign-in pages. Your profile now opens with your totals.

items.title: Small fixes
items.detail: Tournament tables no longer show up in your list of cash games.

releases.title: A slicker table, co-hosts and optional accounts

items.title: A slicker table
items.detail: Bigger cards tucked into each player's nameplate, a clean middle with the pot above the board, and bets that sit just outside each seat. The table fills your window, so Stud fits on a laptop screen without scrolling.

items.title: Fuller sounds
items.detail: New, richer sounds for cards, chips and checks, and a softer marimba to tell you it's your turn.

items.title: Real chip colours
items.detail: Chip stacks use casino colours that scale with the blinds, so you can read a bet at a glance.

items.title: Play from the keyboard
items.detail: F folds, K checks and C calls, and R gets a raise ready. Each button shows its key, and "?" lists every shortcut.

items.title: Chips or big blinds
items.detail: Flip the Chips | BB switch at the top of the table (or press B) to see every stack and bet in big blinds.

items.title: Bots with names
items.detail: Each practice bot gets its own short name and robot picture, like Ace, Lucky or Ducky.

items.title: Co-hosts for cash tables
items.detail: Open the People list (the 👁 button, or ☰ then People on a phone) and make a friend a co-host. They can approve seats and run the game while you play.

items.title: Sign in on any device
items.detail: Create an account with a username and password, then sign in on your phone, laptop or tablet to play as yourself with the same name, picture and notes. Guests can still play without signing up.

items.title: Your history comes along
items.detail: When you create an account, everything you've played on that device stays yours. Sign in on another device and what you did there as a guest moves into your account too.

items.title: Your profile
items.detail: A new profile page shows your cash games with your result at each table, and your tournament finishes. Change your name, picture or password there, sign out, or delete your account.

items.title: Sign in with Google
items.detail: Skip the password: continue with your Google account, or link it to the account you already have from your profile.

items.title: Forgot your password?
items.detail: There's no email, so ask the site admin for a one-time reset code and enter it on the Forgot password page.

items.title: Small fixes
items.detail: Your mood emoji stays with you when a tournament moves you to a new table, and a hand shown after it ends now appears in the replayer.

releases.title: Practice bots, a new look and fair dealing you can check

items.title: Practice bots
items.detail: Add a bot to any empty seat of a cash table and practice any game for free, including Stud, Razz, Triple Draw and Badugi. A player's bot needs the host's OK, like any seat.

items.title: A new look
items.detail: A clean, flat felt with new cards, seats with pictures, chips and buttons. On phones the seats spread out evenly and run-it-twice boards stay clear of them.

items.title: Fair dealing you can check
items.detail: Every deck is sealed before the deal and mixed with a random seed from each player's browser. Press "Check this hand" in the replayer to verify any hand, and read how it works on the Fairness page.

items.title: Roadmap and suggestions
items.detail: See what's coming next on the Roadmap page, send your own ideas, and follow what happens to them in the suggestion log.

items.title: Smoother cash games
items.detail: Shorter game names, hi-lo games labelled 8 or better, and fixes for players leaving all in, tables shrinking and phones dropping out.

releases.title: Tournament formats, host tools and table extras

items.title: Find tournaments easily
items.detail: The home page lists upcoming and running tournaments. Turn on browser alerts, chat in the lobby, and links show a proper preview in WhatsApp.

items.title: New tournament formats
items.detail: Bounty and progressive knockout events, invite codes, check-in, and season leaderboards that add up points across nights.

items.title: Tournament host tools
items.detail: Co-hosts, seat moves, custom stack approval and copying an old tournament's settings.

items.title: Cash game host controls
items.detail: A waitlist, seat shuffles, spectators with a delay, chat settings and saved table presets.

items.title: Table extras
items.detail: Avatars, emotes, stacks in big blinds, all-in odds, sounds, keep-screen-awake, and install the site on your phone like an app.

items.title: Better records
items.detail: Share a hand with a link, hand highlights, and full log downloads.

items.title: Every game
items.detail: Hold'em, Omaha and Omaha Hi-Lo, Seven Card Stud, Stud Hi-Lo, Razz, 2-7 Triple Draw and Badugi, with a How to play guide for each one.

items.title: Extras for everyone, free
items.detail: Run it twice, straddles, bomb pots, the 7-2 bounty, double board, game rotation, rabbit hunting, the time bank and the Nit game.

items.title: Tournaments that start on their own
items.detail: Schedule one and it starts at the set time. Sit & Gos, recurring events, late registration, rebuys, add-ons and custom payouts.

items.title: Ledger, replayer and stats
items.detail: Settle up after the game, replay any hand, and see your stats and notes on players.
